# DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy

> Year-round indoor baseball and softball instruction in Fair Lawn, New
> Jersey. Lou DiChiaro has taught Bergen County players for twenty-five
> years. Hitting, fielding and pitching for ages six to eighteen, in a
> 5,500 sq ft facility built for it.

Address: 18-01 Pollitt Drive, Fair Lawn, NJ 07410
Phone: +1-201-773-6858
Email: info@dichiarobaseball.com

## Pages

- [About · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/about): Lou DiChiaro has been teaching hitting and fielding since 2000. The academy he built in Fair Lawn runs seven days a week, year round.
- [Camps & Clinics · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/camps-and-clinics): Open baseball and softball camps and clinics in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Little League training camp, infield camp and Monday Hit Nights, for players from six to eighteen.
- [Contact · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/contact): Contact DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy, 18-01 Pollitt Drive, Fair Lawn NJ. Questions about camps, clinics, lessons or renting the facility.
- [Facility & Rentals · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/facility-and-rentals): Rent a cage or the full 5,500 sq ft indoor facility in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Cages from $35, team workouts by request, HitTrax booked on its own or added on.
- [DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy · Fair Lawn, New Jersey](https://dichiarobaseball.com/): Year-round indoor baseball and softball instruction in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Hitting, fielding and pitching for ages six to eighteen, in a 5,500 sq ft facility built for it.
- [Instructors · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/instructors): The coaching staff at DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Former college and professional players teaching hitting, fielding, pitching and catching.
- [Lessons · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/lessons): Private and semi-private baseball and softball lessons in Fair Lawn, New Jersey. Hitting, fielding, catching and pitching, seven days a week, year round.
- [Lou’s journey · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/lous-journey): Four years a starter at Seton Hall, a 19th round pick by the Baltimore Orioles, and more than twenty five years teaching the game in Bergen County.
- [Privacy policy · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/privacy-policy): What DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy collects, why, how long it is kept, and what a parent can ask to have removed.
- [Lou DiChiaro’s Infield Camp · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/program): Fifteen Saturdays of infield work for grades 4 to 8 and high school. Ground ball approach, footwork, double plays and relays, taught by Lou DiChiaro in Fair Lawn, New Jersey.
- [Team & town camps · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/team-camps): Over thirty teams train at the academy each winter. Blocks run six, seven, eight or ten weeks, built around your season. Call (201) 773-6858.
- [Terms & conditions · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/terms-and-conditions): The terms that apply to booking a program, a lesson or the facility at DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy.
- [Waiver & policies · DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy](https://dichiarobaseball.com/waiver-and-policies): The participation waiver, refund terms and academy policies for DiChiaro Baseball & Softball Academy.

## Notes
